slots.name: resignation date
slots.sentence: After stepping down as the music director of the Berlin State Opera a year later and amid numerous canceled performances, Barenboim has appeared occasionally with the Staatskapelle Berlin, the Berlin Philharmonic and at La Scala in Milan.
